sources: Judge & Cable (2004). The effect of physical height on workplace success and income. Journal of Applied Psychology 89(3). Four longitudinal datasets (~8,500 people, US & UK) + meta-analysis of 45 studies; each inch ~ $789/year; 6' vs 5'5" ~ $166,000 over 30 years, controlling for gender, age, weight; self-esteem/social esteem explanation. Via APA Monitor 2004.
